scenario: A cheaper default model is adopted overnight while longer reasoning and more experiments raise billable usage; aggregate spend initially stays flat.
mechanism: Opposing price, mix, and volume effects hide material behavioral change in a single dollar-series detector.
detection: Monitor exact model mix and token categories, active users and calls/session, effective rates, and constant-price usage counterfactuals.
response: Retain component changes and joint continuation scenarios; do not claim no change or automatic savings from a flat total.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: construct offsetting rate and usage changes; component evidence changes while the accounting total stays constant, and the explanation reports unresolved continuation.
residual_limit: Early offsetting behavior cannot identify future demand elasticity or sustained use.
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt: new-model price and adoption challenge; ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1-2

scenario: A provider export fails during a public model release and team spending appears to collapse.
mechanism: Missing observations align with a plausible contextual explanation, encouraging false attribution to cheaper-model adoption.
detection: Connector health, coverage intervals, raw event counts, freshness, and unaffected comparable scopes.
response: Mark incomplete coverage, suspend affected activity updates, and retain the model-release claim as unconfirmed context.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: remove an export partition while adding a release document; the forecast never converts missing usage to zero or labels the decline as supported substitution.
residual_limit: A simultaneous real decline remains unidentified until independent or recovered evidence arrives.
owner: Backend coverage; forecasting fitness gate; Factory evidence
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; frontend-plan.md unavailable/delayed data

scenario: Late research charges arrive just after a project moves to engineering; an arrival-time chart shows an engineering surge.
mechanism: Receipt time is confused with incurred time and current mapping overwrites historical ownership.
detection: Event/received timestamps, charge revision lineage and effective-dated team mappings.
response: Revise the appropriate historical financial basis, replay affected model state, and retain as-of forecast evidence.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: backfill pre-transfer activity after transfer; no new present-period activity break is learned merely from arrival, and totals reconcile under the explicitly chosen ownership basis.
residual_limit: Provider records without service dates or ownership history require unresolved attribution.
owner: Backend temporal ledger and mapping; forecasting replay

scenario: A tool-schema deployment invalidates reusable prompt prefixes; cache writes and input overhead jump, then cache warms and costs recover.
mechanism: A temporary configuration-driven pulse resembles a permanent workload regime shift.
detection: Prompt/schema versions, cache-category meters, tool tokens and comparable task volume over warm-up and recovery.
response: Compare pulse, step and reversible-state candidates; retain actual financial exposure even if the long-run activity model stays stable.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: inject a cache-miss pulse followed by recovery at unchanged workload; no irreversible full-history deletion occurs, and pulse costs remain included in incurred estimates.
residual_limit: Unlogged configuration changes may remain causally unresolved.
owner: Backend meter/configuration evidence; forecasting intervention response
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md distinguish usage/cost and preserve assumptions; 14-S11

scenario: A company enables a new default tool for every developer in one day, then disables it after a short trial.
mechanism: A monotonic slow diffusion model cannot represent a centralized switch, initial exploration, and abandonment.
detection: Eligibility/default-setting effective dates, distinct activation and active-use counts, per-user intensity and rollout cancellation evidence.
response: Offer immediate-switch and reversal candidates; preserve previous regime state and avoid treating seats as guaranteed use.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: daily step-up then reversal is representable without an enforced minimum rollout duration; forecast scenarios retain access/use distinction.
residual_limit: Usage after a short trial may not identify steady-state adoption.
owner: Forecasting adoption/scenario model; backend settings; Factory context
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt adoption-delay challenge; internal-team-discussion.txt new tools; 14-S10

scenario: A team moves work from a monitored API to self-hosted inference while a narrative claims the model is free.
mechanism: Observed vendor charges fall but GPU, hosting, operations or other commitments are outside the target scope.
detection: Migration/configuration context, declining monitored task share, coverage registry and separately evidenced hosting costs where available.
response: Forecast monitored charges on their stated basis; label all-in cost unavailable or partial and create a separate migration-cost scenario if inputs exist.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: zero monitored API charges after migration cannot produce a supported zero all-in AI-cost claim.
residual_limit: Complete economic cost cannot be recovered from absent billing categories.
owner: Backend target coverage; forecasting scope; Factory explanation
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt cheaper/open-source substitution challenge; ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1-2

scenario: An adaptive ensemble promotes a model using incomplete 30-day outcomes while late charges favor a different contender.
mechanism: Premature labels, mixed forecast origins, and double-counted revisions corrupt online losses and weight updates.
detection: Outcome maturity status, forecast-origin keys, available-at timestamps and revision-aware score lineage.
response: Keep pending losses, use a declared provisional/final target policy and revise each outcome contribution exactly once.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: withheld charges cannot influence earlier weights; the same finalized outcome and revision affect the appropriate score without duplicate training contribution.
residual_limit: Rapid changes can outpace final feedback even with correct accounting.
owner: Forecasting evaluation and online updates; backend revisions
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt delayed billing; ai-spend-master-plan.md evidence boundaries; 14-S08

scenario: A legitimate very expensive evaluation job is statistically isolated, and a robust detector discounts it as an outlier.
mechanism: Robust distribution estimation is confused with permission to ignore incurred exposure or budget risk.
detection: Separate absolute cost/exposure checks, job evidence and recurring-project context from regime detector output.
response: Include the incurred job, explain continuation uncertainty and compare one-off versus recurring scenarios regardless of the change alarm.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: suppressing a regime alert never removes a valid charge or its budget-threshold impact; recurring follow-up jobs can support a later adaptation.
residual_limit: A single large event cannot establish its recurrence probability.
owner: Forecasting risk channel; backend ledger; frontend explanation
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md variable usage and accounting distinction; 14-S12

scenario: Research pauses evaluation after a finance warning, resumes next period, and repeats this pattern; the internal allocation itself does not enforce provider usage.
mechanism: Human behavioral feedback and project cycles produce recurring regimes that a permanent reset or budget-as-hard-cap assumption misreads.
detection: Project/calendar and communication evidence, actual observed resumption, and separation of internal budgets from provider limits.
response: Preserve recurrent experts and conditional resume scenarios; do not truncate spend at an internal allocation.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: observed spend can exceed allocation; a temporary pause does not force zero future spend, and prior recurring-state evidence remains retrievable.
residual_limit: Finance action is endogenous to forecasts; causal policy effects need more than correlation.
owner: Forecasting regimes and scenario semantics; Factory context

scenario: A stable company has many correlated small-team streams while two teams undergo opposite real shifts that cancel in company totals.
mechanism: Per-stream thresholds accumulate false alerts; company-only monitoring masks localized changes and allocation risk.
detection: Stable-cohort residuals, team and company component views, shared-source incident grouping and empirical fleet alarm counts.
response: Calibrate an organization-level operational alarm budget, group common incidents, and retain team-level evidence without summing detector probabilities.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: stable correlated replay reports observed fleet false alarms separately from nominal delta; opposite team shifts remain visible despite unchanged company spend.
residual_limit: Sparse teams may have low power; dependence weakens naive multiple-test calculations.
owner: Forecasting detector/evaluation design; backend shared-source metadata
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md company/team planning; mentor-discussion.txt team-specific change; 14-S02 and 14-S03
